en.headline: Police drone operation leads to drug arrest after minivan intercepted on Route 3
en.dek: Officers from New Territories South stopped a seven-seater near Ching Lai Court after spotting unstable driving and an irregular number plate; cannabis and sildenafil tablets were found inside.
body: Police from the New Territories South traffic contingent used drones in an early-morning enforcement operation along Route 3 and Lung Cheung Road on Thursday, targeting traffic offences.

Around 8:40 a.m. officers intercepted a seven-seater private vehicle near Ching Lai Court after it was observed crossing double white lines and travelling unsteadily. The number plate also did not meet standard specifications. When the window was opened officers detected a strong smell of cannabis.

A sniffer dog was called and the subsequent search recovered a quantity of suspected cannabis, cannabis buds and seven sildenafil tablets. The male driver was arrested on suspicion of possessing dangerous drugs. A preliminary drug-driving test was negative.

zh.headline: 警無人機執法截七人車 檢大麻及「偉哥」拘男司機
zh.dek: 新界南交通特遣隊今早在三號幹線及龍翔道一帶用無人機執法，於清麗苑附近截停一輛行駛不穩及車牌不合規格的七人車，車內檢獲懷疑大麻及壯陽藥。
body: 警方新界南總區交通部特遣隊今早在三號幹線、龍翔道一帶展開無人機交通執法行動，打擊違例駕駛。
約上午8時40分，人員發現一輛七人車在清麗苑附近切雙白線及行駛時左搖右擺，車牌格式亦不符規格，遂於呈祥道附近截停。打開車窗後嗅到濃烈大麻煙草味。
其後召來緝毒犬搜查，在車上檢獲一罐大麻花、少量大麻及7粒「偉哥」。男司機涉嫌管有危險藥物被捕。初步毒駕測試呈陰性。
